entries.title: Psalms 146:1
segments: ¶Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, O my soul!

entries.title: Psalms 146:2
segments: While I live I will praise the LORD; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.

entries.title: Psalms 146:3
segments: Do not put your trust in princes, [Nor] in a son of man, in whom [there is] no help.

entries.title: Psalms 146:4
segments: His spirit departs, he returns to his earth; In that very day his plans perish.

entries.title: Psalms 146:5
segments: ¶Happy [is he] who [has] the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope [is] in the LORD his God,

entries.title: Psalms 146:6
segments: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that [is] in them; Who keeps truth forever,

entries.title: Psalms 146:7
segments: Who executes justice for the oppressed, Who gives food to the hungry. The LORD gives freedom to the prisoners.

entries.title: Psalms 146:8
segments: The LORD opens [the eyes of] the blind; The LORD raises those who are bowed down; The LORD loves the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 146:9
segments: The LORD watches over the strangers; He relieves the fatherless and widow; But the way of the wicked He turns upside down.

entries.title: Psalms 146:10
segments: The LORD shall reign forever-Your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
